reproduction_behavior: Standard-library script reads case.json beside itself and prints JSON; default writes no file. Optional --svg-dir writes exactly two diagrams, refusing existing files unless explicit --overwrite. Original data, exact stdout and both original SVG were matched using an isolated copy. Fixed variants and figure labels are authored for this case, not an arbitrary log importer.
limits: Parallel-merge uncertainty and the producer role remain distinct scopes. No whole production discipline or library acceptance.
